title: Nested Signal
description:
A fictional exfiltration exercise left a two-layer encoded message. The instructor confirms the layers are hexadecimal and then Base64:

```
5a32687663335167615734676447686c49484e6f5a577873
```

Decode the hex bytes to obtain a Base64 string, then decode that string.
objective: Recover the final plaintext and submit it as HC{plaintext_with_underscores} (lowercase, spaces replaced by underscores).

hints.text: Hex-decode first: the result should look like a Base64 string ending in no padding.
